summary: Make DeepSeek selected-page image input an explicit saved choice so a Reference evaluation can be frozen to the text model without removing the existing multimodal route.
decision_refs: The first controlled live Reference question used deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp and settled with a QA V3 contract error
The sequence stopped before later questions and the failed call remains durably recorded
The active product direction keeps model reasoning external while CRIP manages explicit, reproducible model profiles and results
approval_evidence: The user approved continued implementation and live comparison of the advanced-model Reference workflow while preserving existing functionality as an additive feature.
known_limitations: Changing the saved capability restarts the local service and applies only to subsequently frozen evaluations.
The text-only choice cannot answer facts absent from selected parser text and does not infer document precedence.
A failed settled provider call is preserved and cannot be retried under the same exact request fingerprint.
